title: Detlev Bronk rumored to be on Majestic 12

tellings.quote: Detlev Bronk was the president of the Rockefeller Foundation. He was rumored to be the Yeah, president. He was rumored to be on the Majestic 12, rumored to do all the early alien autopsies

plain: Detlev Bronk, whom Michels calls the president of the Rockefeller Foundation, was rumored to be on Majestic 12 and to have done all the early alien autopsies. Majestic 12 is a rumored secret group of top officials said to have handled crashed UFOs in the late 1940s. Michels tells this himself in a 2026 episode, framing all of it as rumor.
